description: This source file contains utility functions and asynchronous endpoints for managing and retrieving daily activity and spend analytics data in a FastAPI project. It includes functions for updating metrics, filtering and aggregating records, and fetching paginated or full datasets from a Prisma-managed database, specifically for common daily activity metrics related to AI usage, APIs, and provider performance.

methods.description: Updates a SpendMetrics object with data from a record, summing various token and request counts.

methods.description: Determines if a given tag string should be considered a User-Agent tag.

methods.name: SpendMetrics compute_tag_metadata_totals(records: List[Any])
methods.description: Deduplicates spend metrics for tags using request_id, ignoring User-Agent tags, and aggregates metrics.

methods.description: Updates a BreakdownMetrics object with data from a record, aggregating metrics across various dimensions like model, API key, provider, MCP servers, and entities.

methods.description: Processes a list of spend records, aggregating metrics by date and computing total metrics, returning structured results.
